TEXT: [FI] From there, everything happened really fast...
[FI] Finally, the manuscript was done and handed over for printing...
[FI] We were looking forward to that particular day ---- until...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? The books haven't arrived yet?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes. I even miraculously managed to get an employee to confirm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] They said there was a mistake in the registration form.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Eh? Could it be, the one that I had written...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I wonder why the delivery date was on the first day. Considering that today is the third day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] C-Could it be... My fault...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Indeed. You can't even complete such a menial task. Quite a fool you are.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You can't be serious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Unlike you, I am able to recognize when I should be lying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] So, what are you planning to do to compensate her?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well... when you say "compensate"... Hey, Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] We finished it, but for such a conclusion to await us... Could it be that my precognition has failed somewhere...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So then, what should I do about those books that should've arrived today to be sold? Also, what is the end result for all my passion?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah...S-Sorry...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ah～ah. What a pity. I wasn't able to see your epic doujinshi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my, I didn't think you would be looking forward to it so much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I was only looking forward to see your smug face turn sour as you get ignored and this whole thing becomes a shaming play～

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, this was the perfect chance to bring some attention to my doujinshi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You were just looking to stroke your ego anyway, weren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] This is what happens when many products are gathered. It's all about whether or not they catch the public's eyes.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well well, both of you, calm down.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my, this is...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well... this time, it's entirely due to Kyousuke-shi's careless mistake. That's why, Kyousuke-shi, you must take responsibility.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, well... I have nothing to say. I have no excuses.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Then, as a punishment, Kyousuke-shi will wear this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ahahahahahah! Saori, nice one!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Indeed, this is indeed... a good one.
[FI] N-No way...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Please! F-Forgive me!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my oh my, this is just the beginning?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes, yes. This is still not over yet, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] On the sidenote, it doesn't fit you at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kirino! Don't say such things while snapping away photos!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Y'know... This isn't something you should be able to get away with just a few pictures?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Please forgive me! Whatever the circumstances may be, you people are really taking it too far!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Actually, I wasn't really serious about erasing you from society.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-Is that so!? Then that's really a great help there...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, that's right. However, in fact I think 'this' is quite a rare material to obtain...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh...? K-Kuroneko? W-What are you saying...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I've learned something from this incident.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You've forced yourself into this, and yet nothing good came out of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's why..

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] From now on, you will do as I say, right? Senpai?
